frontier_selector.why: Thoracentesis yielded pale yellow fluid with 1260 WBCs/µL and pleural biopsy showed empyema without granulomas, which are specific findings for Empyema.

support_spans: Thoracentesis yielded pale yellow fluid with 1260 WBCs/µL (87% neutrophils), 1590 RBCs/µL, pH 7.237
pleural biopsy showed empyema without granulomas
patchy, macular hyperpigmented rash on both shins and dorsum of the feet
Chest radiograph demonstrated patchy infiltrates in the right lower zone and obliteration of the right costophrenic angle
decreased breath sounds and vocal fremitus at the right lower chest
